title: An agent with a simple schema is conscious in a simple sense only

statements.text: An artificial agent with an attention schema has a simple version of the information that in humans leads to the belief in subjective consciousness, so it has a simple form of consciousness without cognitive complexity or report. The aim is to deflate consciousness to information and cognitive operations.

sources.quote: In that sense, one could say the agent has a simple form of consciousness, without cognitive complexity or the ability to verbally report.
